step.label: Assess organizational readiness for product transition
step.description: Evaluate workforce capability, skill gaps, and change management readiness across affected departments before initiating product line changes.
step.useCase: HR leadership needs to understand which teams can absorb the product transition with minimal disruption.

step.label: Validate hazardous substance compliance requirements
step.description: Confirm that all materials and substances in the new product formulation meet regulatory standards and safety guidelines across all jurisdictions.
step.useCase: Compliance officers must verify new materials pass safety and environmental regulations before production begins.

step.label: Analyze material and procurement impact
step.description: Review sourcing costs, supplier availability, and invoice patterns for new materials required in the transitioned product.
step.useCase: Procurement teams need visibility into material costs and supplier readiness to budget the transition.

step.label: Execute production line reconfiguration
step.description: Initiate machine setup, production order scheduling, and manufacturing workflow adjustments on the factory floor.
step.useCase: Manufacturing operations need to reprogram machinery and sequence production orders for the new product variant.

step.label: Orchestrate market compliance and customer campaign messaging
step.description: Coordinate regulatory-compliant marketing campaigns and customer communication to ensure consistent, safe product transition messaging across all channels.
step.useCase: Marketing and compliance teams must synchronize customer outreach while ensuring all claims meet regulatory standards.

step.label: Segment customer accounts and target campaign cohorts
step.description: Identify and group customer segments most suited for the transitioned product, then configure personalized campaign strategies per account tier.
step.useCase: Campaign managers need to tailor product transition outreach to specific customer segments and account profiles.

step.label: Automate compensation structure adjustments for new roles
step.description: Recalibrate employee salary bands, incentive structures, and benefits for workers transitioning to new product line responsibilities.
step.useCase: HR payroll operations need to update compensation models to reflect new job functions and skill requirements.

step.label: Validate employee compensation alignment and labor cost forecasts
step.description: Confirm that adjusted compensation budgets remain within approved thresholds and that workforce labor costs are accurately reflected in the transition financial model.
step.useCase: Finance and HR directors must verify that labor cost changes support the overall product transition ROI.
